summary: Verified new Employee-PIN direct login feature (medewerker PIN op /login). Backend: 9/9 NEW pytest cases PASS (employee PIN→kiosk_token+employee+admin_token=null; company PIN→admin_token+admin_user; invalid→401; throttle locks after 8 fails→429; PIN-uniqueness 409 against company-PIN, against other employee with name in detail, and against /auth/kiosk-set-pin with employee PIN). Backend regression 12/12 PASS (test_payment_approval_workflow.py). Frontend mobile 393x852: employee PIN 9999 lands on /kiosk, admin_token absent, kiosk_token set, sessionStorage emp_id/name/pin populated, Beheerder button HIDDEN, Maria K. badge + Uit visible; Uit clears all storage and returns to /login. Company PIN 1234 lands on /kiosk WITH admin_token, Beheerder visible, click navigates to /admin (no second login). Admin email+password regression on desktop also passes. No critical issues.

minor.issue: In-memory PIN_ATTEMPTS uses request IP. Running TestZPinThrottle locks the kubernetes ingress IP for 5min and breaks regression tests in the SAME pytest session if executed afterwards. Workaround: restart backend (in-memory dict) or always run throttle LAST + separate session. The lockout itself is by design but the lack of an admin reset endpoint means rerunning suites within 5min requires supervisor restart.

action_items: Optional: add an admin-only POST /api/auth/pin-throttle-reset endpoint or store throttle in MongoDB/Redis so lockout survives backend restarts and can be cleared without supervisor restart. Currently lockout is per-process in-memory only.
Optional: consider migrating the 5-min lockout window or attempt count to env vars surfaced in admin UI so support can debug.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py L2615-2706: kiosk-pin endpoint now has both company-PIN and employee-PIN branches; logic is clear and uniqueness is enforced upstream at PIN-set endpoints — good defensive design.

/app/backend/server.py L5055-5086: employee kiosk-PIN setter now validates uniqueness across (a) all company-shared PINs and (b) all other active employee PINs across all companies — name of clashing employee included in 409 detail. Globally unique PIN across multi-tenant SaaS is correct given the login endpoint matches any PIN. Solid.

/app/backend/server.py L2727-2729: kiosk-set-pin uses status_code=409 with employee name in detail when admin tries to set a company PIN equal to an existing employee PIN — consistent with employee endpoint.
/app/frontend/src/pages/vastgoed/KioskLayout.jsx L1305-1320: hasAdminAccess state refreshes on 'kiosk-employee-changed' event AND every storage change — Beheerder button toggles correctly. Good.

/app/frontend/src/pages/vastgoed/LoginPage.jsx L70-95: onPinSuccess explicitly removes any stale admin_token before storing the employee session — prevents cross-session leakage if previous user was an admin. Good.

Throttle storage is in-memory per-process — a Kubernetes pod restart wipes lockouts. Acceptable for a single-pod deployment but worth flagging for future horizontal scaling (each pod would have its own throttle state).
